newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Anaheim, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
The City of Anaheim, California, (the City'') intends to receive sealed bids for the above referenced series of Electric Revenue Bonds (the
at the office of O'Brien Partners Inc., 333 South Grand Avenue, Suite 1500, Los Angeles, California 90071.

If no acceptable bid is received on such date, the City will receive sealed bids for the Bonds on such later day or days as shall be determined by the City at the offices of O'Brien Partners Inc. set forth above, until the Bonds are sold or this Notice is withdrawn by the City. The principal amount of the Bonds is subject to adjustment as provided in the Notice Inviting Bids.
The Bonds will be dated October 1, 1996.

Copies of the complete Notice Inviting Bids and Official Bid Form, together with copies of the Preliminary Official Statement issued in connection with the sale of the Bonds and copies of the Resolution authorizing the issuance of the Bonds may be obtained from the Offices of the City's financial advisor, O'Brien Partners Inc., 333 South Grand Avenue, Suite 1500, Los Angeles, California 90071, 213/680- 7768 and 505 Park Avenue, 14th floor, New York, New York, 10022, 212/935-7882.
of the City of Anaheim, California
